action.en: UMN Extension advises harvesting cucumber slicers before fruits become overlarge, yellow-skinned, and full of large seeds. Pick often and handle the vine gently; leaving oversized fruit can reduce continued yield. This is species/crop guidance, not a Marketmore-specific size threshold.

action.en: Cucumber plants produce separate male and female flowers on the same plant. Male flowers commonly appear first; female flowers have a small ovary behind the bloom and need pollen transfer for fruit development. Early flower drop alone is therefore not proof of a plant problem.

action.en: Pick summer squash at the size you prefer, before seeds become large, skins hard and flesh fibrous or watery. Harvest frequently; leaving oversized fruits on the plant can reduce further yield. No cultivar-specific length or maturity day is assigned to this yellow-squash type.
